title: oasis: attack/capture, production bonus, conquest release, map info
criteria:
Oasis attacks, capture and bonuses (T23 part b). Existing: cfg.oasis (bonus 0.25, radius 3, max_per_village 3, respawn_hours, respawn_fraction, animals{rat,spider,boar: def_inf/def_cav/min/max}); Tile columns kind, oasis_type, oasis_owner_village_id, animals (dict unit -> count); combat.ArmyGroup has `stats` (fixed (def_inf, def_cav) per unit) and `upgrades`; worldgen.oasis_animals; worlds.respawn_oases. EDITING RULE: realm/services/military.py, villages.py, conquest.py, views.py and worlds.py hold proofread Thai strings: change them ONLY with small targeted Edit operations (never rewrite whole files). New logic goes into the NEW file realm/services/oasis.py.

== Sending (realm/services/military.py `_check_send`, small Edits) ==
For missions ATTACK and RAID, when there is NO village on the target tile but the tile kind is 'oasis', the target is a valid oasis target (instead of the existing 'no village' problem) subject to: distance (movement.distance with the world size) from the sender village to the oasis > cfg.oasis.radius -> problem (INVALID_TARGET, 'โอเอซิสอยู่ไกลเกินไป'); tile.oasis_owner_village_id belongs to a village of the SAME player -> (INVALID_TARGET, 'โอเอซิสเป็นของคุณแล้ว'); for ATTACK only: the sender village already owns cfg.oasis.max_per_village oases (count Tile rows with oasis_owner_village_id == sender village id) -> (INVALID_TARGET, 'โอเอซิสเต็มจำนวนแล้ว'). SCOUT and REINFORCE at an oasis keep today's behaviour (no village -> INVALID_TARGET). Oasis movements have to_village_id None; nothing else about sending changes (protection rules do not apply to oases; hostile missions still remove the sender's own newbie protection).

== Arrival (new realm/services/oasis.py + a 4-line hook) ==
At the very start of `_resolve_battle_arrival` in military.py add a hook: when m.to_village_id is None and `oasis.resolve_oasis_arrival(s, m, world, now, cfg)` returns True the function returns immediately (the oasis function returns False when the tile at (m.to_x, m.to_y) is not an oasis tile, so the old 'no village -> return trip' path still works). `resolve_oasis_arrival(s, m, world, now, cfg) -> bool` in oasis.py: tile = s.get(Tile, (world.id, m.to_x, m.to_y)); not an oasis -> False. Lock the home village (and the previous owner's village when the oasis is owned by another village) in ASCENDING id order and villages.settle_village each. Defenders: when the tile has no owner: one ArmyGroup(tribe=attacker's tribe, units={animal: count for count > 0}, stats={animal: (def_inf, def_cav) from cfg.oasis.animals}, owner_ref=None) (no group when there are no animals); an owned oasis has no defenders. Attacker ArmyGroup(tribe, units=m.units, owner_ref=m.from_village_id, upgrades=smithy.effective_levels(s, m.from_village_id, now)). result = combat.resolve_battle(BattleInput(mission, attacker, defenders, defender_tribe=attacker tribe, wall_level=0, catapult_target_level=None), cfg, random.Random(f'{world.seed}:{m.id}')). Apply: tile.animals = remaining animal counts (old - losses, zero entries dropped; assign a NEW dict); attacker survivors = units - attacker_losses. Capture: mission 'attack' and result.attacker_won and the sender village owns fewer than cfg.oasis.max_per_village oases (re-checked) -> tile.oasis_owner_village_id = home village id and tile.animals = {}; the previous owner's village (if any) gets villages.after_change after the change, and its owner an 'info' report titled 'โอเอซิสของคุณถูกยึด'. Survivors (if any) return with create_return_movement(s, m.from_village_id, tile.x, tile.y, m.player_id, survivors, {}, now, cfg). The attacker gets a 'battle' report: title f'โจมตีโอเอซิส' for attack / 'ปล้นโอเอซิส' for raid, or 'ยึดโอเอซิสสำเร็จ' when captured; data: mission, attacker {player, village {id,name,x,y}, tribe, units, losses}, defenders [{'player': 'สัตว์ป่า', 'village_id': None, 'tribe': None, 'units': animals before, 'losses': animal losses}] (empty list when none), target {'village_id': None, 'name': 'โอเอซิส', 'x', 'y'}, attacker_won, attack_power, defense_power, loot {'wood':0,'stone':0,'iron':0,'food':0}, wall {'before':0,'after':0}, catapult None, loyalty None, oasis {'type': tile.oasis_type, 'captured': bool}. Finish: m.status = 'done'; villages.after_change(home); notify the attacker (and previous owner). Return True.

== Production bonus (realm/services/villages.py `compute_rates`, small Edit) ==
After the gross production is computed: n_t = number of Tile rows with oasis_owner_village_id == village.id and oasis_type == t for each resource t; the gross of resource t is multiplied by (1 + cfg.oasis.bonus * n_t) (bonuses add up: two wood oases = x1.5). Only gross production (before upkeep) is scaled.
== Conquest release (realm/services/conquest.py `conquer_village`, small Edit) ==
Oases owned by the conquered village become free: UPDATE Tile SET oasis_owner_village_id = NULL where it equals target.id (done after the culture settle, before the owner change).
== Map info (realm/services/views.py + worlds.get_map, small Edits) ==
`MapTile` gets a new last field `oasis: dict | None = None`; get_map fills it for tiles of kind 'oasis' with {'owner_village_id': int | None, 'owned_by_me': bool (the owning village belongs to player_id), 'animals': total animal count} (None for other tiles).

== Tests == tests/services/test_oasis.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=2, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); A = the human village at (0,0) with rally_point level 1 (slot 39); the oasis tile (2,0) forced with direct writes: kind 'oasis', oasis_type 'wood', oasis_owner_village_id None, animals {'rat': 10, 'spider': 0, 'boar': 0}, and no village on it; Movement rows are inserted directly and military.resolve_arrival(s, movement.id, arrive_at, cfg) called; human tribe stonehold). Hand-computed (speed 1): ATTACK with 30 swordsmen: attack_power 1200.0, defense_power 10*25 + 10 = 260.0, attacker wins, attacker losses {'swordsman': 3} (int(30*(260/1200)**1.5+0.5) = 3), the 10 rats all die (tile.animals has no positive counts), the oasis is captured (tile.oasis_owner_village_id == A.id), a 'return' Movement with {'swordsman': 27} to A, report title 'ยึดโอเอซิสสำเร็จ' with data oasis.captured True; production: A's wood rate afterwards is 8*1.25 = 10.0 per hour (stone/iron/food rates unchanged) and with TWO wood oases owned 8*1.5 = 12.0 (second oasis forced at (-2,0)); RAID with 30 swordsmen: attacker loses 3 (int(30*0.0916+0.5), x/(1+x) with x = 0.10086), defenders lose int(10*0.9084+0.5) = 9 -> {'rat': 1} remain, NO capture, return movement {'swordsman': 27}, title 'ปล้นโอเอซิส'; failed ATTACK with 5 swordsmen (A = 200 < 260): attacker loses all 5 (no return movement), the rats lose int(10*(200/260)**1.5+0.5) = 7 -> {'rat': 3} remain, no capture, report attacker_won False; capacity: sender owning 3 oases -> send_troops ATTACK at a 4th oasis raises INVALID_TARGET 'โอเอซิสเต็มจำนวนแล้ว' (RAID still allowed); radius: oasis at distance 5 -> INVALID_TARGET 'โอเอซิสอยู่ไกลเกินไป'; own oasis -> INVALID_TARGET 'โอเอซิสเป็นของคุณแล้ว'; SCOUT at an oasis -> INVALID_TARGET; stealing an owned oasis: tile owned by the bot village B (B within the sender's... the oasis within radius of A), animals {}: ATTACK with 10 swordsmen wins (defense 10), tile owner becomes A, B's player gets an 'info' report 'โอเอซิสของคุณถูกยึด', and B's wood rate loses its bonus; conquering village B (conquest.conquer_village) frees its oases (owner None); integration: send_troops to the oasis then realm.engine.worker.process_next(s, world, arrive_at, cfg) runs the battle; get_map around (0,0) r=3: the oasis tile has oasis == {'owner_village_id': A.id, 'owned_by_me': True, 'animals': 0} after capture and {'owner_village_id': None, 'owned_by_me': False, 'animals': 10} before; non-oasis tiles have oasis None; an attack at a coordinate that is neither a village nor an oasis keeps returning the units (old behaviour).
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY these exact strings (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'โอเอซิสอยู่ไกลเกินไป', 'โอเอซิสเป็นของคุณแล้ว', 'โอเอซิสเต็มจำนวนแล้ว', 'โจมตีโอเอซิส', 'ปล้นโอเอซิส', 'ยึดโอเอซิสสำเร็จ', 'โอเอซิสของคุณถูกยึด', 'สัตว์ป่า', 'โอเอซิส'. Do not retype or alter any other Thai in the existing files.
- Real columns only in tests (Tile, Troop, Village, Building, Player.protection_until).
- Use the same helper style as the other resolve functions (reports.create_report, notify.notify, create_return_movement from military via a lazy import inside oasis.py to avoid an import cycle at module load: `from realm.services import military` inside the function body).
- Never commit; never call datetime.now(). Existing tests must keep passing.
